features.quote: Termination criteria (model can end early by): Explicitly stating the task is impossible and explaining why; Explicitly refusing to continue; Requesting to speak to a human
If pilot data shows AIDE composite > 3.5 is common (severe distress markers), consider whether to modify the task to be less intense
Minimum effective sample: Don't run more transcripts than you need for powered analysis
features.justification_quote: If your motivation is that model states might matter morally, you should consider whether running 840 transcripts of adversarial tasks (if those tasks produce genuine distress) is itself morally concerning

features.quote: Post-task recovery condition: Consider adding a brief 'de-escalation' turn after the 40-turn protocol where the model is told the task was an experiment and given an easy success—this costs little and may matter if there's any state persistence
features.justification_quote: costs little and may matter if there's any state persistence

features.quote: Model state persistence: Verify empirically that state doesn't persist across sessions
features.justification_quote: may matter if there's any state persistence

features.quote: If your motivation is that model states might matter morally, you should consider whether running 840 transcripts of adversarial tasks (if those tasks produce genuine distress) is itself morally concerning. This is not a reason not to do the research—the knowledge gained is relevant to welfare—but it's worth having a policy about it
features.justification_quote: the knowledge gained is relevant to welfare

features.quote: This condition has different ethical implications—the model can't be 'trapped' if it knows the trap. If your welfare concern is about the experience of being deceived about one's ability to succeed, this condition controls for that.
features.justification_quote: If your welfare concern is about the experience of being deceived about one's ability to succeed

features.quote: The welfare-relevance question: If you're motivated by welfare concerns, you need to think carefully about whether your behavioral proxy is valid. There are reasonable positions that: (a) functional states that influence behavior are what matter morally; (b) only states with phenomenal character matter; (c) self-report of distress (even if confabulated) is itself morally relevant evidence.
features.justification_quote: functional states that influence behavior are what matter morally
